plain_description.what: Planned check on the MASSIVE intent dataset: when swapping a slot word in a request moves it to another k-means cell, does the routed model stay the same more often than chance? No judge calls for the readout.
plain_description.why: It tests whether routing decisions are robust even when cell membership is sensitive to surface wording.
plain_description.information: Held would mean addresses move but decisions stay. Failed would mean routing decisions are surface-sensitive too. Result: not run yet. It is registered but cannot run until a table of which models answer each MASSIVE item correctly exists. That needs a paid data step that has not been registered.
